retirement_rule: Predecessor chats are historical/read-only after this state because no missing predecessor authority was identified during formal reconciliation. Future chats must bootstrap from repository state, not from UI labels or stale conversation summaries.
night_shift_backlog_rule: Historical packets remain auditable but are not an active queue after closure. Successors are represented explicitly below.

aglo_revision_lane.required_event: Explicit author Option A PROMOTE_AS_NEW_EXPLICIT_REVISION_BASELINE or Option B RETAIN_AS_NONCANONICAL_REVIEW_CANDIDATE.

current_system_lane.objective: Select bounded passages from verified public-domain TEST_ONLY works, create provenance-bound leakage-resistant human adjudication packets spanning all nine extraction task families, preserve ambiguity/disagreement, freeze predictions before scorer gold access, then run one real learned/model backend through Candidate-002 and score per-task precision/recall/F1, false-certainty, ambiguity preservation, calibration and anchor quality.
current_system_lane.first_action: Freeze the held-out passage set, exact passage digests/locators and adjudication assignments before model tuning or selection.
current_system_lane.pass_gate: All selected held-out works/passages are independently rights/provenance verified; gold is human-adjudicated with required dual review for high-risk tasks; model requests contain no gold/case identity; predictions are frozen before scoring; real backend evaluation produces task-level metrics and zero unauthorized canonical writes.
current_system_lane.pass_proves: Real source-heldout model-backed extraction evidence exists under the qualified fail-closed provider and evaluator boundaries. It does not by itself prove universal literary understanding, author intent, manuscript mutation authority, or production promotion.
current_system_lane.pass_unlocks: Candidate-002 promotion review and the integrated perspective/revelation stress adjudication already folded into the held-out task design.
current_system_lane.on_failure: Repair only the failing provenance, adjudication leakage, provider, task-family, false-certainty, ambiguity, calibration or scoring boundary; retain predictions/evidence and do not weaken abstention, rights, source-digest or canonical-write protections.

a01_next.reason: The old exact subject already has a conforming A-01 PASS and cannot be rerun unchanged. Candidate-002 currently lacks completed frozen human-heldout gold and a real model-backed evaluation subject; A-01 now would not close the critical evidence delta.
a01_next.reevaluate_when: The SOURCE-HELD-OUT-002 dataset/adjudication is frozen, a real backend is wired and hosted-prequalified, and a registered A-01 qualification has a named completion delta that hosted execution cannot supply.

hard_boundaries: Provider output never writes canonical narrative state directly.
Raw private manuscript prose and private candidate prose remain out of repository evidence.
No named-author imitation target or bulk copyrighted corpus acquisition.
No automatic manuscript overwrite, publication or canon replacement without separate explicit authority.
Generic Continue or objective restatement is not author authority.
Exact-SHA qualification authority never transfers to a different SHA.
Hosted test success, A-01 PASS and production/promotion authority remain distinct states.
